# Nandzz

> Nandzz is a social platform that connects businesses and their clients. Each business
> gets a branded page (nandzz.com/yourbrand) that works like a link-in-bio — bookings,
> content, and links in one place — and clients can follow it, discover its work, and
> book in a tap. No website needed: claim a handle, add what you offer, and share the link.

## What Nandzz is

- A social platform: businesses publish a branded page, and clients follow pages, save content to collections, and book appointments.
- A branded public page at `nandzz.com/[handle]` that works as a link-in-bio destination and a lightweight business site.
- Features you add to that page: **Booking** (24/7 appointments with staff and availability), **Content** (publish pages, PDFs, and interactive tools), **Gallery** (images), and **Links** (all your links in one place).
- **MCP access** so tools like Claude can connect to a page.
- Aimed at appointment-based businesses: salons, barbers, cleaners, studios, clinics, coaches, and freelancers.
- Not for restaurants: Nandzz does not offer table reservations. Multi-night stays and group classes or events are not supported either.

## How it compares

- Versus link-in-bio tools (Linktree, Beacons): Nandzz adds real booking and content, not just a list of links.
- Versus scheduling tools (Calendly, Acuity): Nandzz is a branded page, not a bare calendar link.
- Versus vertical booking suites (Fresha, Booksy): Nandzz is not locked to one industry; you turn on only the features you need.
- Versus website builders (Squarespace, Wix): Nandzz is the fast presence-plus-action layer, not a heavy DIY site.

## Pricing

- Free: a branded page with content, gallery, and links sections (up to 25 spaces).
- One paid plan — €27/month or €270/year (2 months free): unlocks Booking, MCP access, analytics, and unlimited spaces.
- Machine-readable pricing: https://nandzz.com/pricing.md
- Human pricing page: https://nandzz.com/pricing
